_provenance.question: AGENTS.md detector acceptance criterion: dataset-size ablation, mAP at ~5k / 20k / 50k training frames.
_provenance.val_split: /opt/the-eyes-data/synth50k_v2, 9988 frames, IDENTICAL across all three arms
_provenance.method: train.py --fraction subsets the TRAIN split only, so all three arms share one generator config, one scene-sampling distribution and one val split. Three separate generations would have differed in scene sampling as well as in size, confounding the comparison.
_provenance.training: 40 epochs, batch 64, imgsz 640, seed 20260820, patience 15, deterministic, yolov8n.pt COCO init, depth stem inflated from mean(RGB). Identical across arms; only --fraction differs.
_provenance.note_50k: The 50k arm is runs/detector/rgbd_50k_v2, trained 2026-09-04 and NOT retrained for this ablation. Same script, same hyperparameters, same seed.
_provenance.evaluation: All three best.pt re-evaluated here in one pass via evaluate_one(), rather than reading final-epoch rows out of each results.csv, so the three points come from one consistent val invocation.
